ios.desc:
Send notes, reminders, todos, files, or pictures to yourself in one tap.

Yoyo allows you to set your email addresses once and then send emails to yourself in one tap. Simple and convenient. 

Features:

- Set multiple email addresses (e.g., personal and professional).
- Dark mode.
- Customize email subject and from fields.
- Send multiple files at once.
- Share extension (send from other apps).
- Compatible with all email addresses.

quotes.text:
I am simply using emails. I have dished out every notes apps, emails are great to store memos / notes / reminders / posts... You can search them easily, tag them, filter them. And I do not depend on another third party, well only on my email provider. Also you are sure to come back to your bookmark as it land to your inbox, it doesn't die in an app you will never open. I have build a simple iOS and Android app to send links, images, notes, reminders in one tap by email, you simply register your email once and you re done. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/boomerang-email-myself/id1154427984 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.boomerang.app&hl=en
